{{Top|notoc=1}}
A '''railgun''' (alternatively spelled '''rail gun''') or '''electromagnetic projectile launcher'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> was a projectile launcher which launched a solid projectile with electromagnetic force.<ref name="NEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref><ref name="Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> Considered rare and exotic, these weapons were no longer in common usage by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], however, [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] would sell select pieces to buyers.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

These weapons were used during the [[Rise of the Empire era|rise of the Empire]] by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] employed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. These weapons were small handheld weapons which produced muzzle flash, left tracer fire, and made a "chattering" sound upon firing; the projectiles fired from these weapons were capable of damaging [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="Yoda" />

Another type of railgun was the [[miniature rail cannon]].<ref name="NEGtD" /><ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
